label: Investigación cinematográfica
principles: The speaker's audio order stays intact; the visual layer imposes the investigation structure (anomaly, question, evidence, turn, stakes, open case).
The real source enters first, zoomed to the exact line; the speaker interprets it after.
Everything is muted except one brand accent color, which means 'this matters'.
Three transitions repeated with intent (defocus, zoom-through into evidence, shape match cut), plus J-cuts on sound.
Original music as one continuous arc with a single silence at the turn.
No red-string boards, permanent glitch or evidence without a visible source.
